title: Natural-Language-Guided Generator-Agnostic Shortlisting for Protein Binder Design
abstract: arXiv:2608.20755v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modern de novo design workflows generate many candidate protein binders, but wet-lab validation capacity remains limited, making shortlisting a major bottleneck. We study whether LLMs can generate multi-metric ranking policies from precomputed structural-confidence and interface-quality proxy scores. Rather than proposing a new protein binder design pipeline, we focus on post-generation binder shortlisting: selecting the final top-K candidates from already generated binder pools using a shared panel of precomputed proxy scores. On the 10-target held-out split, averaging performance over five sampled global iterative gpt-4o policies reaches 0.589 Recall@10, modestly improving over the strongest single-feature fixed baseline, Protenix binder ipTM, which reaches 0.571 Recall@10. translated_title: 自然语言引导的生成器无关蛋白质结合剂设计候选筛选
translated_abstract: 现代从头设计工作流程会生成许多候选蛋白质结合剂，但湿实验验证能力有限，使得候选筛选成为主要瓶颈。我们研究LLM能否从预计算的结构置信度和界面质量代理评分中生成多指标排序策略。我们不提出新的蛋白质结合剂设计流程，而是专注于生成后的结合剂筛选：使用共享的预计算代理评分面板，从已生成的结合剂库中选择最终的前K个候选。在10个目标的保留测试集上，对五个采样的全局迭代gpt-4o策略进行平均，达到了0.589的Recall@10，略微优于最强的单特征固定基线Protenix binder ipTM（其Recall@10为0.571）。在包含Nipah、RBX1和TREM2的3个目标保留子集上，目标条件化的迭代gpt-5.4策略达到了最强的LLM性能，Recall@10为0.519。
tldr: 本文提出利用LLM从预计算代理评分生成多指标排序策略，以改进蛋白质结合剂候选筛选，在多个目标上超越了单一特征基线。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes using LLMs to generate multi-metric ranking policies from precomputed proxy scores for improved protein binder shortlisting, outperforming single-feature baselines across multiple targets.
